title: Fictional Digital Access Specification (Synthetic Demo)
disclaimer: Entirely invented for academic UI testing; not CCC/OEM requirements.

requirements.heading: Session Timeout
requirements.text: In this fictional demonstration, a session SHALL expire 60 seconds after the final authenticated activity.

requirements.heading: Timeout Exception
requirements.text: A device MAY extend its active session by 30 seconds when a fictional maintenance mode is enabled.

requirements.heading: Authorization Check
requirements.text: Before granting fictional access, the controller SHALL verify the device authorization token.

requirements.heading: Revoked Device
requirements.text: A revoked fictional credential SHALL NOT authorize access even when a wireless connection is established.

requirements.heading: Proximity Detection
requirements.text: The fictional controller SHOULD begin proximity evaluation when an authorized device enters the demonstration area.

requirements.heading: Connection Loss
requirements.text: When the demonstration radio connection is lost, the fictional application SHALL mark the current session as interrupted.

requirements.heading: Audit Event
requirements.text: The fictional application SHALL record a non-identifying event code when an access request is rejected.

requirements.heading: Offline Mode
requirements.text: If fictional offline mode is configured, a previously authorized device MAY request local access for up to five minutes.
